text:
deploy-bot: starting split rollout rl-5823001111 route=/api/v2 initial 10% -> 50% over 30m
alex: noticed a bump in 502s from mobile traffic in eu-west-1 about 90s after the canary started
priyanka: i can see it too. sample log:
```
[eu-west-1] 2026-03-20T11:56:12Z GET /api/v2 502 "client=mobile-sdk/2.1.0" headers: {"X-Client-Version":"2.1.0","x-client-signal":"v2"}
```
sam: can we pause the rollout while we investigate? mobile is high qps for several tenants
jordan: +1 to pause. sounds like header normalization mismatch. if so, we should pin impacted tenants to v1
deploy-bot: to pause run:
```
/deploy pause-rollout rl-5823001111 --route /api/v2 --reason "mobile header case mismatch"
```
maria: pinging mobile-sdk eng for a patch. estimate ~1h to build + canary, ~2h to reach all clients
priyanka: digging: some en-route proxies in eu-west are strict about header case; v2 path expects lowercased signal header
alex: ops-bot, give top mobile clients hitting /api/v2 with mobile-sdk=2.1.0
ops-bot: top offenders by qps: orb-ventures, quickmart, healthsync, edu.plus, transitly
sam: i'll pin orb-ventures and quickmart now. commands:
```
/deploy pin-client orb-ventures --route /api/v1 --reason "compat: header-case"
/deploy pin-client quickmart --route /api/v1 --reason "compat: header-case"
```
release-manager: add a short release-notes line: "Pausing v2 rollout for select mobile clients due to header-case compatibility; SDK patch in progress." will prepare CS blurb
jordan: is auto-fallback enabled? we have a UA/header-based fallback to v1 for header mismatches
priyanka: fallback is enabled globally but a few legacy proxies had fallback disabled; eu-west had one old proxy
maria: i've asked infra to relax header enforcement in eu-west1 (flag header_case_relax=true)
priyanka: after the flag change 502s in eu-west fell back near baseline
alex: good. mobile SDK team ETA ~45m for a client-side fix
release-manager: posted the release-note draft + CS template in #customer-support
deploy-bot: rollout paused rl-5823001111 at 10% (operator: sam). state=PAUSED
sam: keeping paused until SDK patch is verified and we have a 30m stable window. unpause steps documented
jordan: when resuming, suggested resume plan: 5% for 15m -> 25% for 20m -> 50% then full. also add auto-rollback: if 5xx rate >1% for 5m, rollback to v1
maria: monitoring dashboards on watch :eyes:
priyanka: saving logs and adding a postmortem stub to track header normalization tests across proxies
alex: i'll update the internal incident ticket with pinned tenants and the canary-playbook
ops-bot: pinned clients recorded: orb-ventures, quickmart
sam: confirmed pins and pause. will resume when SDK verification done. closing thread context
ops-bot: thread closed by operator sam at 1769765789 — rollout remains PAUSED
